recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫染色中，濾泡間區呈棕色陽性、寬大的同心圓套區陰性，中央小型退化生發中心內只有零星陽性細胞並有血管穿入，呈 T 細胞標記的分布；可看出 Castleman 病的洋蔥皮套區與棒棒糖血管。標記未標示。
features: Positive interfollicular zones with a T-cell-type distribution
Broad negative mantle zones arranged concentrically around a small germinal center
Small regressed germinal center with scattered positive cells and a penetrating vessel
Multiple follicles with similar expanded negative mantles
Low-power pattern only; cytologic detail not assessable
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified, distribution typical of a T-cell marker such as CD3) on a lymph node shows positivity predominantly in the interfollicular zones, with only scattered positive cells within a small regressed germinal center. The surrounding broad, concentrically layered mantle zone is negative, and a vessel penetrates the germinal center. The preserved compartmentalization with expanded onion-skin mantles and an atretic, vascularized germinal center is consistent with hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: AITL shows expanded interfollicular atypical T cells co-expressing PD1/CXCL13/CD10 with extrafollicular CD21+ FDC meshworks.
Paracortical hyperplasia expands the T zone with immunoblasts but has normal follicles without onion-skin mantles or atretic germinal centers.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mantles are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD5-positive B cells rather than unstained polyclonal B cells.

stain: IHC: marker not specified (T-cell pattern, likely CD3), DAB
